about.text: Raw milk with some or all of its cream taken off, once by letting it rise and skimming it by hand, now by spinning it off in a centrifugal separator. What is left is the starting point for semi-skimmed and skimmed milk.

how.text: The skim milk is what is left of raw milk when the cream has been spun off: it is the other half of the same separating step and still raw until it is heat-treated.
